scope: The generic fan lemma is proved for a compact convex polygon represented by its vertex list, convex hull, and exact cyclic boundary-edge presentation. From actual compactness, the ray through any non-apex point has a last point on the polygon frontier; the point lies between the apex and that exit. Boundary membership then places it in an edge triangle. A separate barycentric height argument shows that a point below the apex in the closing triangle must equal the apex, including degenerate/boundary cases. The n>=2 indexing and exclusion of the closing edge are proved. No triangle-cover conclusion is assumed in the polygon representation. Existing actual seven-vertex cover proofs remain linked.
